patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with dramatic background changes define distinct content blocks, often featuring large-scale typography or video.
Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif typography is used for key section headings, creating strong visual impact and acting as graphic elements.
Abrupt, full-screen background color shifts (from dark video to vibrant green to light gray) are used to delineate major content sections.

The navigation bar dynamically changes its background color and opacity as it scrolls, transitioning from a transparent overlay to a solid green, then to a solid light gray, while remaining sticky at the top.
Sections reveal with a full-screen transition, where the entire viewport background color and content dramatically shift as the user scrolls past a certain point.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed background video with a dark, desaturated overlay to ensure text legibility. This video scrolls out of view to reveal subsequent sections.

The navigation bar implements a scroll-triggered transformation, starting as a transparent element with a subtle backdrop blur, then becoming a solid, full-width bar with a distinct background color that changes based on the active scroll section.

Major content sections are introduced with full-viewport background color changes, creating a strong visual break and a sense of progression as the user scrolls. Large, graphic text elements are often integrated directly into these full-bleed sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide, and bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong graphic statements, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for sections and most elements, with subtle rounding (~4-8px) used for smaller components like news popups and image cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and full-screen text sections, creating a sense of grandeur; balanced density in content grids for readability.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, full-screen background color and content shifts on scroll, creating a highly dynamic and almost theatrical progression through the page. This, combined with the use of extremely large, graphic typography and a navigation bar that visually transforms with each section, makes for a memorable and impactful user experience.
